answer: In AI agent economies, Sybil resistance relies on each agent maintaining a unique economic haven of bonded tokens proportional to its activity volume. The system verifies these bonds continuously against on-chain logs and applies penalties for discrepancies. An attacker seeking many identities must therefore lock substantial capital for every fake account, driving costs prohibitively high. Meanwhile, any gale of suspicious requests is blocked by karst-shaped multi-tier reputation barriers that form gradually through authentic peer attestations.
